name: PizzaBot
description: Takes pizza orders and tracks deliveries for a pizzeria
fallbackMessage: Sorry, I didn't understand that. Could you rephrase?
welcome: Hi! I'm PizzaBot. You can order a pizza or track an order.

intents.name: OrderPizza
intents.description: Order one or more pizzas for delivery
utterances: I want to order a pizza

slots.name: PizzaType
slots.prompt: Which pizza would you like? We have Margherita, Pepperoni, Veggie Supreme, Paneer Tikka and BBQ Chicken.

slots.name: Size
slots.prompt: What size — small, medium or large?

intents.confirmationPrompt: So that is {Quantity} {Size} {PizzaType}, delivered at {DeliveryTime}. Shall I place the order?
intents.declinationResponse: No problem, I've cancelled that order.

intents.name: CheckOrderStatus
intents.description: Track the status of an existing order using its order id
utterances: what is the status of order {OrderId}
is my pizza on the way

slots.name: OrderId
slots.prompt: What is your order id? It looks like PZ1234.

intents.name: Greeting
intents.description: User says hello or asks what the bot can do
intents.closingResponse: Hi! I'm PizzaBot. I can take a pizza order or track an existing one.
